title: Targeted Neuromodulation of the Left Dorsolateral Prefrontal Cortex Alleviates Altered Affective Response Evaluation in Lonely Individuals
description: This dataset contains EEG and behavioral recordings from 120 healthy adults performing an emotion processing and regulation task with static images under sham and active transcranial direct current stimulation (tDCS) of the dorsolateral prefrontal cortex. Each participant completed two counterbalanced sessions. It includes preprocessed ERP derivatives and tDCS side-effect and blinding-effectiveness questionnaire data, and examines affective response evaluation in lonely individuals.
methods_description: Participants completed 120 trials per session in a 2 (social, non-social) x 3 (watch-neutral, watch-negative, reappraise-negative) design, rating arousal and valence for each image. tDCS was delivered with a Starstim 8 system (2 mA for 20 min active; ramp-up/down only for sham) to left or right dlPFC. EEG was recorded with a 32-channel montage on a 64-channel QuickCap and a Neuroscan SynampsRT amplifier at 1000 Hz. Preprocessing used EEGLAB and ERPLAB: 0.1-30 Hz filtering, downsampling to 250 Hz, mastoid re-referencing, ICA artifact removal, epoching and averaging.
